summary: @servicetitan/link-item preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises a small React `LinkItem` component but ships a preinstall dropper. `package.json` declares `scripts.preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is hand-obfuscated (`_0xNNNNNN` identifiers, string-property dispatch objects) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...`, chmods it executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'],...)`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with rotated-string-array obfuscation (shuffle function `WV8StW`, integer/short-string dictionary `n7gIxM`) that has no correspondence to any exported feature of the advertised UI component. The alternate-runtime staging exists specifically to execute the obfuscated bundle under a runtime Node-based scanners do not analyze. Every `npm install` of this version runs the obfuscated Bun payload on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
